6ab1390ed837fb541981a167.description: This Tex-Mex spot is known for its signature hand-squeezed lime margaritas and a menu featuring scratch-made sauces like the popular creamy jalapeño. 6a1f49eba193b5028183c5ad.name: Lewis Barbecue
6a1f49eba193b5028183c5ad.description: Lewis Barbecue brings authentic Central Texas-style barbecue to Greenville, featuring legendary brisket and house-made sausages. Guests can enjoy their meal in a laid-back atmosphere with a spacious backyard patio and honky-tonk music.

6a1f49eba193b5028183c550.description: Located in the heart of downtown Greenville, Roost Free Range Kitchen & Bar offers a fresh take on traditionally-inspired dining. The restaurant features a creative menu focused on locally sourced ingredients served in a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere.
